Finally, a solid red line, labeled “ffn_residual”, begins at approximately 20 at layer 0, rapidly increases starting at layer 5 to a value near 1500 at layer 6, remains near 1500 until layer 17, then rapidly decreases to approximately 20 by layer 21.
